name: survos/ark-bundle
description: Symfony bundle for ARK identifier minting and resolution

suggest.api-platform/core: Exposes ArkBinding as an ApiResource with collection/item endpoints.
suggest.survos/field-bundle: Registers ArkBinding in the admin navbar via #[EntityMeta].
suggest.survos/jsonl-bundle: Enables ark:export --output and ark:import --input with .jsonl/.jsonl.gz files.
